II, 13</cite>) <he>הא וָותְרוּ לאלף</he> (not <he>וותרה</he>) were they not numerous up to a thousand?; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6:2">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>הא וותרו למאד</he> (read: <he>למֵאָה</he>).

senses.gloss: to do more than justice requires, to be liberal; to forego one’s rights. Y. Ned. I, beg. 39ᵃ if they had agreed על מנת לוַותֵּר to yield their rights (to allow each other the use of the entire court).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 126a:2">B. Bath. 126ᵃ</cite> <he>בכור … ו׳</he> if a first-born accepted an equal share (of a field) with his brothers, he has renounced his privilege; Y. Keth. IV, end, 29ᵇ <he>חזקה וייתר</he> (read: <cite ref="F00115"><he>וִויתֵּר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 9a:14">B. Kam. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>ו׳</he> he has renounced his rights (cannot resort to his co-heirs for redress).
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:13">Ruth R. to I, 8</cite> <he>שוִיתְּרוּ לה וכ׳</he> they relinquished their claim on her &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be indulgent, forgive. Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᶜ ו׳ הקב״ה על וכ׳ the Lord overlooked Israel’s idolatry, but did not &c.; Lam. R. introd. (R. Abba 2). Y. Sot. V, end, 20ᵈ שהיה מְוַותֵּר על קללתו he pardoned those who cursed him.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 9">Deut. R. s. 9</cite> <he>נְוַותֵּר לו עוד יום וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="P00114"><he>עד</he></cite>) let us give him a respite of one day or two.—
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 21:5">Num. R. s. 21</cite> <he>לא יהא אדם מוותר על התורה</he> man must not be more liberal than the Law; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:5">Snh. XI, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 89a:8">89ᵃ</cite>) <he>המוו׳ על דברי נביא</he> he who disobeys a prophet from mere soft-heartedness (v.

senses.gloss: to give additional space to a plant by removing surrounding plants, to make open space. Y. Shebi. II, 33ᵈ top מְוַותְּרִין בגפנים you may clear (in the Sabbatical year) between the grape vines; ib. מקום שׁנהגו לוותר וכ׳ where it is customary to clear before the festive month; Tosef. Shebi. I, 7 מְוַתְּרִין; ib. להתיר ed. Zuck. (read: לוַותֵּיר).
to be let loose, set free. Midr. P’tirath Mosheh אֶוָּותֵר (Jellinek Beth-ham-Midrash I, 125; v. Lattes Saggio 107).

units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> <he>נִתְוַתְּרוּ מעיו וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 288:1">Yalk. Is. 288</cite> <he>נתרזו בני מ׳</he>) his bowels were loose that whole night.

B. Kam. 50ᵃ bot. יִתְוַותְּרוּ חייו Ms. M. (ed. יִוָּתְרוּ, Nif., v. supra) his life shall be let loose i.e. shall be outlawed; Ar. ed. Koh. יִתְיַתְּרוּן מעיו וחייו (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 26 יתותרון בני מעיו his bowels &c., v. next w.; Yalk. Ps. 648 יִוָּתְרוּ חייו his life be outlawed.
